title: Memo Re Leonid Musin, Possession Of A False Passport

page_data.en:
Copy for Mr. Givens.
No. 125.
MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGT.
10 January 1935.

Sir,

With reference to our correspondence on the subject of Leonid Musin, who was fined $ 80.-- by the Shanghai District Court on 9 November 1934 for being in possession of a false passport, I have the honour to inform you that, according to a communication received from the Police at Utrecht, the original holder of Netherlands passport 389801, Johannes Theodorus Blokker, used it only for travelling to Belgium, returning to Holland in July 1931.

J.Th.Blokker has not left ...... and it is thought his passport was stolen from his overcoat in December 1931.

I should be greatly obliged therefore if you could let me know whether Musin applied for a visé with the Chinese Consulate in Marseilles on 7 June 1932 (visé No.5568) and whether, on arrival in Shanghai on 12 July 1932, he has filled in the official Chinese forms.

If there should be evidence that some person other than Musin travelled on Blokker's passport to China, I should be grateful for any information it might be possible to furnish me in this connection.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
(sgd.) Jan v.d. Berg
(印：Shanghai Municipal Police)

H.E. Mr. Givens,
Director of the Passport and Registration Office
of the
Bureau of Public Safety,
SHANGHAI.
page_data.zh:
致吉文斯先生副本。
第125号。
工部局警务处
S. B. 团
1935年1月10日。

先生：

关于我们关于列昂尼德·穆辛（Leonid Musin）一案的往来信函，此人因持有伪造护照于1934年11月9日被上海地方法院罚款80美元。兹荣幸告知，根据从乌得勒支警方收到的函件，荷兰护照第389801号的原始持有人约翰内斯·西奥多鲁斯·布洛克尔（Johannes Theodorus Blokker）仅将该护照用于前往比利时旅行，并于1931年7月返回荷兰。

J.Th.布洛克尔未曾离开……据信其护照于1931年12月从其外套中被盗。

因此，如蒙告知穆辛是否曾于1932年6月7日向中国驻马赛领事馆申请签证（签证号5568），以及他于1932年7月12日抵达上海时是否填写了中国官方表格，我将不胜感激。

若有证据表明除穆辛以外的其他人持布洛克尔的护照前往中国，如能就此提供任何信息，我将深表感谢。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
（签名）Jan v.d. Berg
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处）

致：
吉文斯先生阁下，
上海市公安局
护照登记处处长，
上海。
